Interactive research sample

NYS DOCCS Recidivism Interactive Dashboard

Return-to-custody outcomes, county variation, and prison facility context

Explore three-year return-to-custody outcomes by release year, age at release, gender, return type, and county of indictment. The recidivism outcome file currently ends with the 2021 release cohort because the measure requires a three-year follow-up period. Facility points are contextual only because the public recidivism file does not identify release facility.

Return-to-custody trend

Hover over a point for cohort details. Click a release year to update the dashboard.

Top county comparison

Counties are ranked by the selected metric. The chart is capped at 10 counties for readability. Rates are based on county of indictment, not release facility.

County data table

Use the search box to locate a county. Click the metric dropdown to change how counties are ranked.

County rates and NYS prison facility context

County shading shows three-year return-to-custody rates by county of indictment for 2008–2021 release cohorts. Prison facility locations are shown for geographic context only.

Age at release

Return rates generally decline as age at release increases.

Return status breakdown

Return-to-custody includes parole violation returns and new felony offense returns.

Gender comparison

Sources: NYS DOCCS Recidivism: Beginning 2008; NYS prison facility point layer prepared from public facility information; county boundaries from ArcGIS Living Atlas/Esri. Method note: Public DOCCS recidivism data are reported by county of indictment and do not identify the correctional facility from which a person was released.
